notes: A reply INTERRUPTED mid-stream on Claude Code 2.1.270 with Esc (interrupt_key esc), after the reply had started streaming. The interrupt block reads "⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?", so claudecode.interruptMarker did not move at 2.1.270. Recorded with `make rebake-corpus HARNESS=claude SCENARIO=interrupted-mid-reply WORKDIR=/tmp/hw-rebake/interrupted-mid-reply` from a fresh `git init` directory (holding add.go and sub.go) and an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (onboarding done, permissions.defaultMode auto, static CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, every inherited CLAUDE* session marker removed), so the recording carries no machine path, account setup or nesting warning. The script's answer_dialog step accepted the folder-trust dialog, which claude reset once, as it does to the first Enter. expected.txt is the last live frame rendered by tmux (bytes.raw replayed up to claude's teardown), not by the emulator under test.
